subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.

The mountain peak offers a breathtaking view, a striking contrast to the __________(peculiar) scenery below.
solution:
The correct answer is '**ordinary**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**peculiar**" means something unusual or out of the ordinary.
 
• The antonym of "peculiar" is "**ordinary**" which means normal or common.
 
• The other options: "**beautiful**," "**abnormal**," and "**odd**" do not provide the correct antonym in this context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The mountain peak offers a breathtaking view, a striking contrast to the ordinary__ scenery below.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Beautiful (सुंदर)**: means pleasing to the senses or aesthetically attractive.
 
• **Abnormal (असामान्य)**: means deviating from what is standard or expected.
 
• **Odd (अजीब)**: means strange or unusual.
